typical_weekday_pattern: S-Bahn commute to the office every weekday, leaves the Deutschlandticket to cover everything.
typical_weekend_pattern: Occasional public-transport trips into the city center for errands or seeing friends.
travel_statement: I rely entirely on public transport and don't want to think about tickets.
activity_statement: Mostly home and office, occasional weekend outings by train or bus.

typical_weekday_pattern: Travels to client sites by long-distance train 2-3x/week, regional train for closer meetings.
typical_weekend_pattern: Mostly stays in Frankfurt, occasional weekend trips by train.
travel_statement: I live on the train. The BahnCard 50 pays for itself the moment I book a client trip.
activity_statement: Business-heavy travel pattern with city-transit at each destination.

typical_weekday_pattern: Works from home most days; buys a single ticket on office days, no passes.
typical_weekend_pattern: Occasional e-scooter or single-ticket trips into town.
travel_statement: I don't want to commit to a monthly pass when I barely leave the house some weeks.
activity_statement: Low, irregular mobility footprint - everything paid per ride.

typical_weekday_pattern: Works from home almost every day; walks or bikes for the rare errand.
typical_weekend_pattern: Bikes around the city, rarely touches the subscriptions he signed up for when he still commuted.
travel_statement: I kept the subscriptions from when I worked in the office. Haven't gotten around to cancelling.
activity_statement: Very low overall mobility, almost entirely on foot or his own bike.

typical_weekday_pattern: Just moved to the city; commuting by public transport while learning the routes.
typical_weekend_pattern: Still exploring the neighborhood, infrequent trips.
travel_statement: I just relocated here six weeks ago and got the Deutschlandticket right away.
activity_statement: New to the city, mobility patterns still settling into a routine.

typical_weekday_pattern: Drops kids at school by bike, part-time work via PT, car-sharing for groceries/errands.
typical_weekend_pattern: Family outings by car-sharing, occasional bike trips with the kids.
travel_statement: Between school runs and work, I need whatever's fastest - car-sharing for bulky errands, the Deutschlandticket for everything else.
activity_statement: Childcare-driven schedule with frequent short trips across several modes.
